scope: five narrow original sources; no broad review or external code execution

sources.title: Minibatch optimal transport distances; analysis and applications
sources.verified_claim: The stated OT gradient/expectation interchange uses C1 sample maps, finite moments and an additional integrability assumption.
sources.project_limit: The hard ADC/STE and all original piecewise model operations have not been proved to satisfy these hypotheses; no unbiased classical R65 gradient claim.

sources.title: On Nesting Monte Carlo Estimators
sources.authors: Tom Rainforth, Rob Cornish, Hongseok Yang, Andrew Warrington, Frank Wood
sources.locator: Section 3, fixed-M limiting argument and Theorem 1
sources.verified_claim: For fixed inner sample count the outer Monte Carlo average tends to the expectation of the finite inner estimator's transformed value; Theorem 1 adds Lipschitz and L2 hypotheses for its rate.
sources.project_limit: The project's empirical-measure-valued stratification and ADC surrogate gradients are not directly covered by the rate statement. The convexity/Jensen argument in this memo is independently derived from original D.

sources.title: On the rate of convergence in Wasserstein distance of the empirical measure
sources.verified_claim: Expected empirical transport error is bounded under finite q>p moment assumptions, with dependence on dimension, transport order and moments.
sources.project_limit: Parent independence, acquisition dependence and a fitted-theta uniform generalization argument have not been verified; no numerical project bound or effective sample size is imported.

sources.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
sources.authors: Diederik P. Kingma and Jimmy Ba
sources.verified_claim: The algorithm accumulates first and coordinatewise second raw moments of the supplied stochastic gradient and applies a nonlinear normalized update.
sources.project_limit: The D/C covariance expansion and the preceding combined clip are project-specific analysis, not a convergence guarantee for this constrained neural response.

sources.title: Kernel of CycleGAN as a Principal Homogeneous Space
sources.authors: Nikita Moriakov, Jonas Adler, Jonas Teuwen
sources.verified_claim: Under the paper's pure CycleGAN assumptions, probability-space automorphisms act on exact solutions.
sources.project_limit: R65 has neither the paper's reverse map nor CycleGAN loss. This is not a proof of non-identifiability for R65 after all its constraints.
